newsitem.title: USA: St Lawrence Seaway fees to rise in Aug - agencies.
newsitem.headline: St Lawrence Seaway fees to rise in Aug - agencies.

text.p: Cargo toll fees on sections of the St. Lawrence Seaway will increase in August, officials of U.S. and Canadian seaway agencies said Wednesday.

The U.S. Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation and the Canadian Seaway Authority said the Seaway Tariff of Tolls will be amended to increase cargo toll fees by 2.5 percent on the Montreal-Lake Ontario and Welland Canal areas of the St. Lawrence Seaway. The increase will be effective August 1.
Vessel charge per Gross Registered Ton on the Welland Canal will also increase while lockage charges will be eliminated, the agencies said.
The toll increase is the first along the St. Lawrence Seaway since 1993, agency officials said.
